title: Palak Pakora
description: Crisp spinach fritters bound with a spiced besan and rice flour batter, best with hot tea and green chutney.
steps: Mix the spinach, onion and green chilli in a bowl and add the salt; rest for 5 minutes so the vegetables release moisture.
Add the besan, rice flour, carom seeds and red chilli powder and mix with your hands.
Sprinkle in about 70 ml of water only as needed to make a thick, clinging batter.
Heat the oil in a kadai on medium heat until a drop of batter rises steadily.
Drop small spoonfuls of the mixture into the oil and fry in batches for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and golden.
Drain on paper and serve hot.
